scientific_integrity: Exact finite 225-support-pair enumeration and a mathematically proved lift to arbitrarily many labelled vertices; independent labelled simulations cover 115600 states. No independent audit, mathematical priority determination, or broader-graph claim.
scientific_limitations: The calculation concerns deterministic threshold-one four-state dynamics on labelled loopless complete bipartite graphs. A prior general-color theorem already classified periodic configurations; only basin sizes, all first-entry depths, the sharp cutoff and extinction exponent are advanced as additions. The 1995 one-dimensional source was inspected; unindexed equivalent basin formulas remain a risk.
title: Exact extinction basins and six-step entry for four-state Greenberg–Hastings dynamics on bicliques
